evidence_notes: Official Chapter 4 product information establishes that the DLC contains six costumes/accessories and four Super Souls, but does not provide the item-level reward mapping used here.
The Steam Community guide explicitly presents its PQ data as in-game descriptions and lists the Chapter 4 reward inventory, making it useful secondary evidence for identity and quest association.
The existence of PQ 185 and PQ 186 is independently corroborated by recent gameplay listings; those videos are not treated as proof of drop rates or hidden reward conditions.

A current community report associates 'I'll use this power to protect everyone!' with Supreme Kai of Time (Ultra Supervillain), but that report does not establish the full effect, trigger, numerical values, or item-level acquisition route, so no mechanics are promoted from it.

A search result for 'This power... It's different from any I've ever had.' reports a health-below-50-percent effect, but because the available result is secondary gameplay content rather than item-level documentation, the repository retains the effect as unresolved rather than treating the claim as verified.
